responsibility: Defines GCC’s wide-int framework: the generic finite-precision integer classes and traits used to model target-width arithmetic in a type-safe way. This header declares wide_int, offset_int, widest_int, storage and trait machinery, overloaded operators, precision/sign-sensitive wi namespace algorithms, masks and shifted masks, and conversion helpers, making it the primary interface for arbitrary-precision integer math across the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Defines the wide-int class templates, traits, operators, and wi namespace interfaces that wide-int.cc implements. Unlike wide-int-print.h, this header describes the integer representation and arithmetic API rather than just printing support.
